assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: VERY TALL vertical scrolling background for a dark fantasy dungeon game. Create one continuous edge-to-edge environmental illustration, portrait aspect ratio 1:3, ideally 1024 pixels wide and 3072 high. It is a vertical CUTAWAY descent through a dungeon, NOT one long perspective corridor receding to a distant point. Composition: a misty graveyard beside crooked town roofs at the very top, sinking through mossy burial passages, violet-lit tombs and ossuary galleries, down into a great lich crypt with purple spectral light at the very bottom. Floors and winding stairs stack DOWN the canvas with natural transitions, no hard panel borders. The top is above ground, the middle is underground, the bottom is the deepest chamber. Keep the crucial path and changing architecture near the central third so a narrow mobile crop still makes sense. Painterly dimensional dark fantasy illustration matching an atmospheric medieval game. Detailed stone and roots, moderate contrast, enough readable colored light to distinguish depth zones; NOT pitch-black. cool desaturated stone, muted moss, violet spectral lighting. Environment only: no people, heroes, monsters, faces, portraits, text, symbols, floor numbers, UI, border, watermark, or collage. Fill the entire rectangular image. Each vertical region should work as a standalone atmospheric backdrop behind translucent battle cards.
